name: FAIE Evidence-First Signal Brief
problem: A buyer has one bounded agriculture, land, water, production or resilience question and needs a sourced evidence-first investigation.
intent_terms: research this land or water question
give me an evidence brief on this region
inputs: Defined question, buyer email and selected fixed offer. Geography, organization and use case are optional scope context.
outputs: A bounded evidence-first mission packet with findings, source references, uncertainty/evidence-needed items, challenge notes and human-review items.
pricing: Signal Brief $250 one-time; Proof Sprint $2,500 one-time. Other intake categories are not auto-quotable.
confirmation: Explicit buyer confirmation is required before checkout. Verified payment queues a human-controlled mission; consequential claims or actions remain review-gated.
invocation_status: LIVE: FAIE HTTP agent gateway + OpenAPI + llms guidance + remote MCP at https://faie.base44.app/functions/faieMcp. Agents can inspect the fixed $250/$2,500 offers, prepare checkout only after explicit human confirmation, and verify payment/mission queue state. Paid work remains human-review controlled.
